Overview

Duque de Caxias is a city in RJ with a population of 929,449. A densely populated industrial city in Greater Rio, known for its oil refinery, chemical plants, and the Serra dos Órgãos mountain views. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
